title: Niche Validation (PRD-001 output)
description: Output artifact for vibe-us-warm-prd-niche-research. evidence[] uses the COMPANY-WIDE unified evidence contract, inlined identical to _shared/schema/evidence.schema.json#/definitions/evidence_array so the shared validator --run-all can verify verbatim quotes without an external $ref base_uri. Gate encoded with allOf/if-then so Draft7Validator (harness v2) enforces it.

niche.description: Niche label = occasion x relationship x recipient, e.g. 'pet memorial blanket for dog owners'.

demand_score.description: Weighted rubric score (demand40/competition25/margin-fit20/ip-risk15) normalized 0-100. Gate: >=70 to validate.

audience_proxy.description: US addressable-audience proxy (Meta reach or documented estimate). SLO >=500000. If from estimate (no live Meta tool), confidence must drop + need_review=true.

margin_fit.description: good=contribution >=15% comfortably @ target CPA; borderline=only at higher price / lower CPA; poor=below floor -> reject/reprice.

ip_risk_flag.description: Pre-flag only (not official clearance). HIGH -> mandatory PRD-003 before design, cannot auto-validate.

peak_week.description: ISO week or occasion date of demand peak, or 'none' for evergreen.

design_deadline.description: Latest design-ready date; SLO >= 6 weeks before peak.

evidence.description: Unified company evidence contract (inlined from _shared/schema/evidence.schema.json). Each verbatim_quote MUST appear verbatim in the file at `source`.

verbatim_quote.description: Text that appears verbatim in the file `source`.

source.description: Filepath containing the quote (relative to this artifact, or absolute).

confidence_score.description: Analyst confidence AFTER evidence verification. Fail-closed: missing live tool / estimated inputs -> keep < 0.7.

need_review.description: true whenever confidence < 0.7, a required input was estimated, or ip_risk_flag != CLEAR. Blocks auto-validate.

decision.description: validated=handoff PRD-002; watchlist=promising but blocked (Owner decides); rejected=fails floor/IP; refresh=stale, re-run.

allOf.$comment: GATE (PRD-001 §5): decision=validated => demand_score>=70 AND ip_risk_flag!=HIGH AND need_review=false. Enforced by Draft7Validator allOf/if-then.
Fail-closed coupling: if need_review=false then confidence_score must be >= 0.7 (no auto-pass on low confidence).
